name: Frankfurt
registryBasis: Frankfurt’s Stadtvermessungsamt publishes the city-only WFS Flurstücke service. The official city service metadata identifies the ALKIS parcel layer, and the official catalogue describes parcel boundaries and related cadastral objects. A schema-first anonymous request confirmed a polygon geometry field (SHAPE) and an integer object ID (OBJECTID); a geometry-only bounded query returned three complete parcel polygons near the WUP point.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
scopeLimits: 191 valid, distinct Frankfurt municipal cadastral polygons verified in thirteen local 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged WUP settlement locator. The service-advertised GEOJSON response preserves native EPSG:25832 boundaries, transformed with an explicit ETRS89 projection. FSK is native cadastral identity; OBJECTID/GmlID remain transport identity. Stable hit counts before and after all pages, strict default OBJECTID order, forced three-row pagination, all 191 fresh native FSK reads through FES equality, valid synthetic absence, footprint and source binding passed. Independent GEOS in EPSG:32632 found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Unsupported application/json and sorting requests, and the different POST serializer, remain documented; the executable profile uses only supported GET operations. Wider municipal completeness, legal boundary accuracy and long-term identifier continuity remain unverified.
remainingUncertainty: The city catalogue says the WFS contains Flurstück, historical Flurstück, boundary and administrative cadastral types and that the data is only for Frankfurt city. Three sample polygons were taken within a 240 m by 170 m EPSG:25832 bbox around the WUP point; they do not prove citywide completeness. The dataset is licensed under Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0.

executedQueries.query: Frankfurt am Main official city ALKIS parcel WFS polygons open data Flurstücke
executedQueries.scope: Find exact-city cadastral service and verify safe schema and geometry-only sample.
executedQueries.result: The city surveying office provides geodata and the city publishes a parcel WFS. Public WFS capabilities and DescribeFeatureType identify the Flurstueck feature type, SHAPE MultiSurface geometry, and OBJECTID integer. A server-side allowlisted query for OBJECTID and SHAPE returned three polygons in a bounded area around the WUP point.

executedQueries.query: Frankfurt am Main Stadtvermessungsamt WFS Flurstücke ALKIS Flurstück Geometrie
executedQueries.scope: Städtischen Katasterdienst und ein sicheres Geometrieschema am konkreten Standort prüfen.
executedQueries.result: Das Stadtvermessungsamt Frankfurt stellt den WFS Flurstücke bereit; der Dienst gilt laut Metadatensatz nur für das Stadtgebiet. Capabilities und DescribeFeatureType bestätigen Flurstück mit SHAPE als MultiSurface-Geometrie und OBJECTID als Integer-ID. Die Geometrieabfrage übermittelte serverseitig nur OBJECTID und SHAPE und gab drei vollständige Polygone zurück.

officialSources.observation: Official city page describes the Stadtvermessungsamt as Frankfurt’s municipal surveying office and its geodata-provision function.
Official city page presents the Frankfurt geoportal/geodata infrastructure and open-data portal.

Official German government open-data catalogue lists the WFS Flurstücke Frankfurt am Main, publishing authority Stadt Frankfurt am Main – Stadtvermessungsamt, city-only coverage, and Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0.

Direct WFS GetCapabilities returned HTTP 200 and five feature types. DescribeFeatureType for Amt62_Flurstuecke:Flurstueck returned OBJECTID xsd:int and SHAPE gml:MultiSurfacePropertyType among the schema fields. Only OBJECTID and SHAPE were requested for sample data.
